spec_case: issue #725/#726 (params_json never sets within, even rendered from state)
description: A trusted document's params_json is a Mustache template that only becomes the JSON object {"within": ...} once rendered from a prior effect's own state, so the compiler's own literal-JSON sniff at compile time never sees it; the dispatch-time check still refuses it, with the same text a literal params_json override gets.
